## Checklist (see CONVENTIONS.md)
- [ ] The behaviour is tested; `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run verify` pass
- [ ] No name, list or constant tied to one protocol; every figure comes from the snapshot
- [ ] `dashboard/` is still under its size budget; screenshots retaken if the page changed
- [ ] An ADR note if the model or the layout changed
